purpose: Independent-source replication of the published Ethereum Flow Deviation relationship at the single highlighted 45-day horizon. This is a literature replication, not a new-discovery claim.

literature_formula.smoothed_flow_intensity: 30-day simple moving average of daily flow_intensity
literature_formula.reference_rate: 90-day trailing median of raw daily flow_intensity

implementation_clarification: The 90-day reference is applied to raw daily FI because the public methodology explicitly says 30-day-smoothed FI is compared with a 90-day trailing median of FI. No alternate smoothing/reference variant will be opened.

holdout_prediction.coefficients: Frozen alpha and beta estimated only from 2024 discovery-fit rows whose 45-day exits occur no later than 2025-02-14. No refit on holdout.
holdout_prediction.benchmark: constant mean forward 45d log return from the 2024 discovery-fit sample

promotion_boundary: A pass does not equal a tradable strategy or diamond.
This sample overlaps the published research era and therefore is not a protected post-publication holdout.
A pass authorizes only a separately pre-frozen executable translation or forward watch.
no_rescue: Do not choose a different post-Dencun start after outcomes.
Do not change Coin Metrics metrics after outcomes.
